description: The plot illustrates the relationship between “Initial Confidence” on the x-axis and “Accuracy” on the y-axis, showing how model performance changes as initial confidence varies. The x-axis spans from 0.91 to 0.98 in linear increments of 0.01, labeled “Initial Confidence,” while the y-axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear steps of 0.2, labeled “Accuracy.” Three distinct lines are plotted: a solid blue line with circle markers remains consistently high, hovering near 1.0 across all confidence levels, with slight dips around 0.93 and 0.97. An orange dashed line with diamond markers starts at approximately 0.62 at 0.91, peaks near 0.95 at 0.92, then steadily declines to about 0.08 at 0.98. A green dash-dotted line with square markers begins at 0.2 at 0.91, dips slightly to 0.08 at 0.92, then rises steadily to approximately 0.85 at 0.98. Error bars are present on all data points, indicating variability in measurements. The gray square legend entry is present but not associated with any plotted line, suggesting it may be a placeholder or unused category.
